opening.argument: The presentation demonstrates Cake Wallet’s MWEB privacy features through concrete wallet controls and application updates. The speaker identifies confidential transactions, stealth addresses and CoinJoin, explains the Peg In and Peg Out buttons, and describes native MWEB support in Cake Pay. The discussion also acknowledges a practical limitation: enabling the feature requires an initial download of around 600 megabytes of data. Viewers are invited to try Cake Wallet, but the cited presentation describes no payment requirement, credential request, promised financial return or deceptive claim. Its focus remains on how the feature works and what using it requires.
